config.label: Control plane URL supplied by your mesh operator
config.description: Control plane URL supplied by your mesh operator. HTTPS is required beyond loopback unless explicitly permitted below.

config.label: Absolute path to a bootstrap token file for first enrollment
config.description: Absolute path to a bootstrap token file for first enrollment. Set this OR AGENTMESH_JWT_PATH; leave both empty only when resuming saved credentials.

config.label: Absolute path to an OIDC/workload token file
config.description: Absolute path to an OIDC/workload token file. Alternative to the bootstrap token; reread during credential refresh.

config.label: Absolute directory for this client identity
config.description: Absolute directory for this client identity. Use a distinct directory per client and mesh. If omitted, uses ~/.config/agentmesh/mcp.

config.label: Allow plaintext HTTP beyond loopback
config.description: Allow plaintext HTTP beyond loopback. Development only: exposes enrollment traffic to the network.
